text: When a watchmaker collapses and dies outside a shopping mall, his widow Patricia and their children Alfredo, Julián and Sabina are left without a provider and with [a family ritual of cannibalism|origin|family blood and inheritance] to keep. The brothers prowl the streets for someone to bring home, [a prostitute, a homeless child, a young man from a bar|who_suffers|outcasts and the marginalised], while two detectives chasing glory follow a finger found in the father's stomach. Patricia insists that [one of them must survive to carry on the ritual|ending|the evil is handed on].
